correctness.rationale: For all integers p,q>=3, the exact dominance-Alexander-dual face identity, box-nerve intersection criterion and equivariant proper-row/column-support map are proved. Each lower fiber is a simplex. Integral Kunneth gives three sign lines; natural Alexander duality contributes the board orientation determinant and degree N-i-3. Board transpose contributes binomial(n,2) cell transpositions and graded flip sign (n-2)^2. Rational transfer gives all subgroup quotient Betti numbers. The included standalone finite program independently matches signed simplex Lefschetz sums, orbit sums and formula for 45 selected actions, and averages complete groups of orders 72,144,1152. The finite check is not a proof of the infinite claim.

A yet-unidentified equivariant source remains possible.

value.rationale: The full integral S_p times S_q representation, board-transpose action and arbitrary-subgroup rational quotient formula are intrinsic invariants of a canonical automorphism-rich graph family. They distinguish rationally acyclic full quotients from rational homology spheres by board-size parity modulo four, a phenomenon invisible in the previously known nonequivariant sphere-wedge classification. The statements are motivated by symmetry of the natural graph construction, not arbitrary parameter slices or face-table recomputation.
